decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-070e2e78535d] names one exact subject, the Prometheus metric `cilium_triggers_policy_update_folds`, and says it has been removed in the 1.17 "Removed Metrics" upgrade notes. That is a plain removal with no replacement given, and the evidence does not bundle other changes or point to other documents. The section context shows the related trigger metrics were removed alongside it as separate items with no replacement ([ev-72ecae3c2fc1], [ev-fd031f140d8c]). Removal itself means the metric is no longer emitted, so an engineer can write the consequence: anything that queries the metric gets no data. Applicability can also be written: environments that scrape or query this metric are exposed. Whether a given customer does that is decided later per environment, not missing release-level evidence.
